name: Page shell, survival chart and controls
description: A static page that loads the table, runs the engine once per setting change, and plays the cohort forward one year at a time with a survival curve and live statistics. Files: index.html, src/app.mjs, src/chart.mjs, styles.css. No particles yet. Everything local, no CDN.

userStories.title: index.html and src/app.mjs show the starting figures
userStories.description: Create index.html that links styles.css and loads <script type=module src=src/app.mjs>. It contains: <select id=sex> with options male (selected) and female; <input type=number id=startAge min=0 max=90 value=0>; buttons #play #pause #reset; <canvas id=chart width=800 height=400>; and three elements #age #alive #pct. src/app.mjs fetches data/mortality.csv, calls parseTable, keeps one state object { table, sex, startAge, improvement:0, currentAge, playing:false, baseline:[], }, computes baseline = survivors(1000000, table[sex], startAge), and renders: #age shows `Age ${currentAge}`, #alive shows survivors at currentAge with toLocaleString('en-GB'), #pct shows one decimal place followed by %.
acceptanceCriteria: python3 -m http.server 8080 then http://localhost:8080/ shows 'Age 0', '1,000,000' and '100.0%' with no console errors
Changing #sex or #startAge recomputes baseline and updates the three figures immediately
View source shows no http:// or https:// URLs

userStories.title: Play, pause, reset
userStories.description: In src/app.mjs: #play sets playing=true and starts a requestAnimationFrame loop; every 250 ms of elapsed time (accumulate performance.now() deltas, do not use setInterval) currentAge increases by 1 until it reaches 121, where playing becomes false. #pause sets playing=false. #reset sets currentAge=startAge and playing=false. Changing #sex or #startAge while playing behaves like reset then applies the new setting.
acceptanceCriteria: Play from 0 reaches 'Age 121' and '0' survivors in about 30 seconds and stops
Pause then Play resumes from the same age
Reset returns to the starting age with 1,000,000 shown
Changing startAge to 60 while playing shows 'Age 60' and 1,000,000

userStories.title: Survival curve src/chart.mjs
userStories.description: Create src/chart.mjs exporting drawChart(canvas, series, currentAge, startAge). series is an array of { values, colour } where values is an lx array starting at startAge. Draw: dark background, x axis age from startAge to 121 with a tick and label every 20 years, y axis from 0 to 1,000,000 with a tick and label every 200,000 written as '200k', each series as a 2px line, and a 1px vertical line plus a 6px filled circle at currentAge on the first series. Clear the canvas at the start of every call. app.mjs calls drawChart on every state change and every frame while playing.
acceptanceCriteria: The curve starts at the top left at startAge and reaches 0 at 121 on the right
The marker x position moves right as the age increases and matches #age
Resizing the window keeps the chart legible (canvas width set from its CSS width on resize, then redrawn)

technicalNotes.rationale: DOM wiring and canvas drawing, fully specified.
